subject: Proposal: wheel-up demo windows for Helix Health deep-dive
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Moreno <elena@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: wheel-up demo windows for Helix Health deep-dive

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call:
- Primary goal: validate Redwood inference for Helix Health’s clinical-scheduling workload (low-latency routing + audit logs).
- Key stakeholders: Product (you), IT/security (Michael), and 2x backend engineers who will join the technical deep-dive.
- Constraints: must support EU data residency for patient metadata and have SOC2 evidence for logging.

Next steps I propose: a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive where we:
1) run a short walkthrough of our serving runtime with a sample scheduling flow,
2) demonstrate prefix caching and routing policies for multi-tenant clinical workloads,
3) answer the security/architecture questions your IT team has.

To make the session workable across Helix’s US/EU/APAC teams, I sketched a simple rotating-window plan (attached as "calendar-rotor.csv"). The idea is a repeating 3-week "wheel" where each region gets a preferential morning slot at least once every week so local ops can join at convenient times. Sample slots (all times local):
- Week A: US morning / EU afternoon / APAC evening
- Week B: EU morning / APAC afternoon / US evening
- Week C: APAC morning / US afternoon / EU evening

Attached: demo ops playbook (20280620-demo-ops-playbook.pdf) and a rough calendar export (calendar-rotor.csv). I also attached the signed NDA we received earlier (helix-nda-signed.pdf) for reference.

Can you confirm:
- Who from IT/security will join (Michael was mentioned)?
- Whether you prefer a 60 or 90 minute slot?
- Any blackout days next two weeks?

If helpful I can propose three specific meetings next week that follow the wheel pattern and include Ben (solutions), Priyom (tech enablement) and our TSE.

Best,

Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Attachment stubs: 20280620-demo-ops-playbook.pdf (PDF), calendar-rotor.csv (CSV), helix-nda-signed.pdf (PDF)

From: Elena Moreno <elena@helixhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Turner <michael.turner@helixhealth.com>, security@helixhealth.com
Date: 2028-06-20T23:04:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: wheel-up demo windows for Helix Health deep-dive

Thanks Rishi — great summary.

A few quick notes:
- Confirmed attendees: Michael Turner (Dir, IT Ops) and our lead backend engineer, Priya Singh (I copied security@ for the SOC2 intake).
- Preference: 90 minutes would be better so we can allocate 20–25 mins to security questions.
- Availability: next week our core EU devs are flexible mornings (09:00–11:30 CET) on Tue/Wed/Thu. US team prefers mornings PST (08:00–11:00) on Tue/Thu. APAC can join evenings SGT (18:00–20:00) on Mon/Wed.

I like the wheel idea — it should help us rotate burden across teams. One ask: can you include a brief agenda slide for the security portion (what logs are available, retention controls, KMS/HSM options)? Michael will want that before confirming.

If you can propose two concrete slots that match our EU morning preference, I’ll route them internally for confirmation.

Best,
Elena
VP Product, Helix Health
elena@helixhealth.com

On Tue, Jun 20, 2028 at 15:12, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (original message)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Moreno <elena@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T02:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: wheel-up demo windows for Helix Health deep-dive

Elena —

Thanks, that works. Quick answers and two proposed slots that fit your EU morning window:

Security agenda: we will send a single-slide summary before the meeting that covers:
- Audit logs: token-level request/response tracing, retention options (30/90/365 days), and export formats.
- Data residency: model routing patterns and how we pin logs to EU regions.
- Key management: KMS integrations and HSM options for private deployments.
- SOC2 evidence: pointer to our compliance kit and responsible contacts (we’ll include a link to the SOC2 PDF in the calendar invite).

Proposed slots (both 90 mins CET start):
1) Tue Jun 27, 09:30–11:00 CET (this maps to Mon Jun 26 00:30–02:00 PDT — US evening; APAC midday)
2) Thu Jun 29, 10:00–11:30 CET (maps to Thu Jun 29 01:00–02:30 PDT — US early morning; APAC late evening)

If either works I’ll create calendar invites that follow the wheel pattern so subsequent sessions rotate regional preference (we’ll label the recurrence "Helix wheel: technical deep-dive series"). If you prefer, I can also publish the two-week wheel PDF in advance.

Ben / Priyom / Monica — looping you in to confirm who will present which segment (Ben: runtime + cost/perf; Priyom: deployment/topology; Monica: security & audit).

Rishi

--
Attachment stubs: security-agenda-onepager.pdf (will be uploaded before the invite)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T09:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: wheel-up demo windows for Helix Health deep-dive

Rishi —

I can take the runtime demo and the cost/perf portion. Priyom can cover topology and the private deployment options; Monica will do security + SOC2 Q&A.

A couple of operational notes before we finalize the slot:
- Please set the invite with a clear attendee list and add a short pre-read (I suggest the demo ops playbook PDF + the SOC2 extract).
- Add a Zoom link that records the session and enable the muted join option; Helix asked for the recording to be available for downstream stakeholders.
- We should include a 10-minute buffer at the end for next-step alignment (follow-up PoC timeline + decision criteria).

I’m available for either proposed slot; I lean toward Thu Jun 29, 10:00 CET so our US folks get a slightly earlier start.

Ben
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0123
